title: BIPM decides to stop adding leap seconds to UTC
summary: BIPM (International Bureau of Weights and Measures) has voted to stop adding leap seconds to UTC by 2035, ending a decades-long practice that caused complications for computer systems and global time synchronization.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for irregular time adjustments that complicate computing and navigation systems
why_valuable: Simplifies global timekeeping and reduces technical burdens on computer systems that struggle with discontinuous time adjustments
